title: eriogonum covilleanum subsp. adsurgens
intro: Eriogonum covilleanum subsp. adsurgens, commonly known as a type of buckwheat sagebrush, is a perennial shrub native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. The plant has been used in traditional medicine to aid in the treatment of various health issues, including respiratory problems, due to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties, which provide relief from coughs and congestion. The bioactive constituents of Eriogonum covilleanum subsp. adsurgens include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its therapeutic actions and health benefits. The plant is also valued for its antioxidant properties, which help to protect against cell damage and oxidative stress.
